description: This file defines an abstract class QueryBase for building entity queries in Drupal, including methods for conditions, sorting, pagination, and class resolution.

classes.name: QueryBase
classes.description: An abstract base class for entity queries in Drupal, implementing common query functionalities and class resolution.

methods.name: getEntityTypeId
methods.description: Returns the entity type ID associated with the query.

methods.name: condition
methods.description: Adds a condition to the query based on property, value, operator, and language code.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Adds an existence condition for a property.

methods.name: notExists
methods.description: Adds a not-exists condition for a property.

methods.name: range
methods.description: Sets the range (offset and limit) for the query results.

methods.name: conditionGroupFactory
methods.description: Creates a group of conditions with specified conjunction (AND/OR).

methods.name: andConditionGroup
methods.description: Creates an AND condition group.

methods.name: orConditionGroup
methods.description: Creates an OR condition group.

methods.name: sort
methods.description: Adds a sort condition on a field with specified direction.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Sets the query to be a count query.

methods.name: accessCheck
methods.description: Enables or disables access checking for the query.

methods.name: currentRevision
methods.description: Configures the query to target the current revision.

methods.name: latestRevision
methods.description: Configures the query to target the latest revision.

methods.name: allRevisions
methods.description: Configures the query to include all revisions.

methods.name: pager
methods.description: Sets pagination limits and element ID.

methods.name: initializePager
methods.description: Initializes pager settings and counts total results.

methods.name: tableSort
methods.description: Applies table sorting based on headers.

methods.name: __clone
methods.description: Clones the query object, including its condition object.

methods.name: addTag
methods.description: Adds a tag to the query for later identification.

methods.name: hasTag
methods.description: Checks if a tag is present.

methods.name: hasAllTags
methods.description: Checks if all specified tags are present.

methods.name: hasAnyTag
methods.description: Checks if any of the specified tags are present.

methods.name: addMetaData
methods.description: Adds metadata to the query.

methods.name: getMetaData
methods.description: Retrieves metadata by key.

methods.name: aggregate
methods.description: Adds an aggregate expression to the query.

methods.name: conditionAggregate
methods.description: Adds a condition on an aggregate expression.

methods.name: sortAggregate
methods.description: Adds sorting over aggregate results.

methods.name: groupBy
methods.description: Adds a group-by clause on a field.

methods.name: getAggregationAlias
methods.description: Generates an alias for an aggregate field and function.

methods.name: getNamespaces
methods.description: Returns a list of namespaces of the class hierarchy of an object.

methods.name: getClass
methods.description: Finds a class in a list of namespaces.

methods.name: alter
methods.description: Invokes hooks to allow modules to alter the query before execution.
